technical_and_design_decisions: All new test code (unit and integration) will use JUnit 5, consistent with Spring Framework 6.0+ codebase standards.

BOM template documentation (U1) will be written in Asciidoctor format and integrated into the official Spring Framework reference documentation, following existing documentation style, structure, and publishing workflows.

The Admin UI container shutdown bug fix (U7) will include a dedicated regression integration test that deploys the exact stream definition from the VESC-504 issue and validates successful container shutdown post-fix.
